decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted, pruned or destroyed during the development phase and thereafter within 5 years of completion of the development, without written approval by the LPA.</p><p><br></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;06; 07; 08; 10;&nbsp; 11 Rev A; 12 Rev A; 13 Rev A; 14; 15; 16 Rev B;&nbsp; 17&nbsp; Rev C; 18; Reasonable Exception Statement;&nbsp;&nbsp;Arboricultural Impact Assessment;&nbsp;Envirosearch Residential;&nbsp;Location Plan; Site Plan (NGL 696783); Flood Risk Assessment; Planning Statement.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The AMS (10.1 – 10.2, DAB_24RPR_AIA_001, Chris Wallis TreeSense March 2025) submitted in support shall be adhered to in full, including all pre-arranged tree protection monitoring and site supervision (detailed in 10.2 and Appendix A, inspection Form) by the appointed specialist. Copies of the completed inspection form shall be emailed to the LPA within 28 days of completion of the development. This condition may only be discharged on completion of the development subject to written evidence of compliance with the approved tree protection throughout construction.</p>

The window(s) in the first floor flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">The development of any building hereby permitted shall not be&nbsp;commenced until Flood Mitigation Measures have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p class="MsoNormal">To ensure that the structure is designed to mitigate the effects of any possible flooding on site or elsewhere and include resistance and resilience to flooding.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The applicant should provide detailed description of building materials, foundations, floor, wall, fittings, services, doors and windows that minimise water entry whilst maintaining structural integrity, materials and construction techniques that facilitate drying and cleaning, in line with 'Improving the Flood Performance of New Buildings' publication taking into account the expected depth of flooding.</p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The development of any buildings hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of surface water have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.</p><p class="MsoNormal">To ensure that the necessary construction and design criteria for the development&nbsp;proposals follow approved conditions according to NPPF.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The applicant should contact Harrow Drainage Section at the earliest opportunity.</p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding the approved details and prior to the commencement of development, full details of the permeable paving and details relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details thereby approved shall be retained thereafter.</p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p>
description: Front porch, Installation of bay window in first floor front elevation,  Single and two storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormers, Roof lights in front roof slope, Brick pillars and iron gates to front,External alterations, Detached single storey outbuilding to rear for use as Study/Gym (Demolition of gate canopy to front, rear extension, detached garage and greenhouse to rear) (Amended Plans)
